regions.merged_text: Mary Kirmann of Bayone N.J. = Tertiary, and promoter of S.M. Assoc., waits from 1 to 7 P.M. to see Lawyer Green for encouragement about a last will and testament unjustly denied her 19 years ago. Green decides case as absolutely hopeless. - Nervous brake-down next day. March 23rd names of opponents are inscribed in S. M. A. - and April 5th following letter is received from hitherto unfriendly lawyer: "Dear Miss Kirmann Will you kindly be at my office next Thursday April 10th at 11 A.M., to receive payment of the legacy due to you under the Last Will and Testament of the late Anna Zindel Very truly yours, C.A. Furriman. April 10th said Miss Kirman accepted $5000.00 as a personal settlement of her part of the said will. She solemnly protested, however that others had been unjustly de- prived of their share. On advice of F. S. Miss K. decieded on said protest before all present - to accept as above - "leaving rest absolutely to God." Same day everyone interested in said will - Enrolled - (Final sentence no longer legible)

regions.merged_text: Conversion after 49 yrs. Mary Galbally, 261 W. 130 St. who en- rolled her Father perpetually on Nov. 6th reports this evening - over-joyed at result - "Papa went to confession and holy Communion this morning for first time in 49 years." She had heard on Nov. 4th of a conversion as through S.M.A. after 35 years, and deter- mined to try the same for her loved Father. She would wish now to proclaim from the mountain tops the goodness of God as through same S.M.A. Today she further more enrolls her invaled - weak-minded - brother who had broken down from excessive penance for Father's con- version some years ago. March 3rd Same (Galbally) is reported as able to be out looking for work.

regions.merged_text: Febr. 14 St. Valentine's. Use of glasses Restored. Mrs. Helen McDonough of 73 - E: 88th St. Extremely anxious lest operation for double cataract be necessary, promises to do all in her power for missions if use of glasses be restored without operation. This was first in nov- ember. She returned on January 20th wearing her glasses but not yet satisfied. She renewed her promise that day and To-day re- turned jubilent and perfectly cured. In fulfilment of her pro- mise she joined herself pertetually, and re-enrolled her parents and brother besides paying for a heathen child (500)
